description:
Load a `data_extract` JSON into a database that was created FROM SCRATCH with the
    same apps installed. Idempotent: re-running creates nothing new (records are matched
    by external id, natural key, or - for document lines - by parent+sequence, because a
    line's `name` is a description and matching on it silently duplicates and DOUBLES the
    order total).

    `with_config` also carries hand-made views, website menus/pages and user filters.
    `reconcile=True` additionally REMOVES records the target has but the source does not
    (Odoo's own demo/default leftovers) - only for a database not yet in use.

    Fields that are computed but carry real values (taxes on an order line) are written
    a second time, after creation, so the new database can't silently recompute a
    different amount. Anything that cannot be resolved is left EMPTY and reported.
name: data_load
